title: Fluid Flow Regulator for the Smart Tech ATF Machines
lead: MOC has designed a new Fluid Flow Regulator to be used with the Smart Tech® ATF machine. This fitting will slow down the fluid exiting a vehicle to improve the 1:1 ratio during an exchange.
body: A kit is now available to add this Flow Regulator to an existing machine.
